name: reliance-playwright
description: Playwright BDD automation for Reliance Jewels

scripts.test: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 npx cucumber-js --config cucumber.config.js && npm run report:html

scripts.report: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 npx cucumber-js --config cucumber.config.js && npm run report:html
